My memory doesn't hold a specific owner requirement about OpenUI mockups for projects that have their own design system, so I won't guess at one.

What I do have is related. The owner chose option C ("Ok do C"), which replaces the OpenUI mockup library. Under C, a component exists once as the project's real file. A "sheet" is a CSF 3 story file beside it. The daemon runs the project's own Vite, Astro, Nuxt or Next with one CawCo plugin. Toolchains that can't take a plugin, like Angular CLI, get an HTML `page` artifact on the project's CSS. The owner chose that HTML/json canvas himself.

The PRD (`.design-foundations/plans/2026-10-06-projects.md`, D29) or the 2026-10-16 spec may hold the original requirement.
